parsed.critic: C03 closely mirrors the strongest observed mix-380, so its high-fly-ash, higher-water combination may cap strength and its disagreement is large; C02's very low water with high superplasticizer risks workability/placement problems that could reduce measured strength.
parsed.selection_rationale: C01 and C03 combine high predictions with near-observed analogues, while C02, C04, and C05 test modest water/slag variations that could exceed estimates, so all merit small-batch measurement.
